about.label: About
about.title: Engineering systems that scale
about.bio1: I'm Jeroham Sanchez — a Senior Fullstack Systems Engineer with 10+ years of experience building production-grade web applications, APIs, and AI-powered systems for startups and enterprises.
about.bio2: My specialty is the intersection of modern web engineering and AI — designing systems that use language models effectively, not just as a gimmick, but as a genuine multiplier for user value.
about.bio3: I work in short, high-quality iteration cycles. You get clean code, solid documentation, and a system you can actually maintain and extend without me.
